problem:
Let 
$T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}x+y \\ 0\end{aligned}].$
Which of the following statements are true?

- $T(kv)=kT(v)$ for any real $2\times 1$ column vector $v$ and real scalar $k$
- $T({v}_{1}+{v}_{2})=T({v}_{1})+T({v}_{2})$ for any real $2\times 1$ column vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{2}$
- $T$ is a linear transformation

choices.value: None of the statements are true

feedback.problem:
Let 
$T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}{x}^{2} \\ 7y\end{aligned}].$
Which of the following statements are true?

- $T(kv)=kT(v)$ for any real $2\times 1$ column vector $v$ and real scalar $k$
- $T({v}_{1}+{v}_{2})=T({v}_{1})+T({v}_{2})$ for any real $2\times 1$ column vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{2}$
- $T$ is **NOT** a linear transformation
feedback.worked_solution:
A linear transformation $T$ satisfies two properties:

$$
\begin{aligned} & T[\begin{aligned}kx \\ ky\end{aligned}]=kT[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}], \\  & T[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2} \\ {y}_{1}+{y}_{2}\end{aligned}]=T[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {y}_{1}\end{aligned}]+T[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

- Checking the first condition, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}T[\begin{aligned}kx \\ ky\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}(kx)^{2} \\ 7(ky)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{k}^{2}({x}^{2}) \\ k(7y)\end{aligned}] \\  & =k[\begin{aligned}k({x}^{2}) \\ 7y\end{aligned}] \\  & \ne kT[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}].\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $\text{T}$ is not a linear transformation.

- Checking the second condition, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}T[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2} \\ {y}_{1}+{y}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}({x}_{1}+{x}_{2})^{2} \\ 7({y}_{1}+{y}_{2})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{2}+{x}_{2}^{2}+2{x}_{1}{x}_{2} \\ 7{y}_{1}+7{y}_{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{2} \\ 7{y}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2}^{2} \\ 7{y}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}{x}_{2} \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =T[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {y}_{1}\end{aligned}]+T[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}{x}_{2} \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & \ne T[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {y}_{1}\end{aligned}]+T[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}].\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

As a result, only statement III is true.
